class: client host behaviour around waiting, resending and recovery: core §4.4 wait floor (every request, the link's own too), §5.1 resend / give-up / result unknown and the boot_id check after it, transports §3/§5 resync, reopen and the probing confirm's last wait, session keepalive / reopen / no_session, boot_id checks (open's reboot), oep-if-link §2/§3 measurement waits and lost revert recovery, DATA0/DATA1 restore before the hart runs, havereset handling, writer lease, end of session

divergences.spec: core §4.4: **この下限はすべての要求に当てはまる**。 / host は要求ごとに**少なくとも**次を待つ: 要求全体の処理時間の上限 + 1000 ms（`host_wait_add_ms`）+ 転送の時間
divergences.code: src/oep_client/link.py:SerialLink._wait (keep_alive, link._keep, SerialLink._step_down revert, link._try.back revert: requests sent under _own)
divergences.fix: _send/_exchange_once set the processing bound of the requests on the wire (_bound_s: Host.op_bound_ms, core_quick_op_max_ms when unknown/unbound); _wait applies wait_floor_s(bound) to every request, _own exempts only reads with no request (pump, repeated confirms)

divergences.spec: oep-if-link §2: host はその応答を、ほかの要求と同じように待つ（core §4.4）。confirm のようには繰り返さない。
divergences.fix: the floor now counts the source / sink requests' own processing bound (max_op_ms) via _bound_s in _exchange_once, not 0 + host_wait_add_ms + transfer

divergences.spec: core §4.4: host は要求ごとに**少なくとも**次を待つ: 要求全体の処理時間の上限 + 1000 ms（`host_wait_add_ms`）+ 転送の時間 ... fn 0のconfirm / list / describe / clock / keepalive / lock_stateの要求全体の処理上限は、max_op_msと `core_quick_op_max_ms`（1000 ms）の小さい方である。
divergences.fix: recover_transport's confirm deadline is max(timeout, wait_floor_s(confirm bound)) instead of max(timeout, host_wait_add_ms + transfer); resync sets the confirm's bound while it reads its answer

divergences.spec: transports §3: confirm の待ち時間（core §4.4。max_op_msの取得前はcore_quick_op_max_ms + host_wait_add_ms（計2000 ms）と転送の時間）が過ぎても正しい confirm の応答が来なければ（送り直したときは、最後の送り直しの待ち時間が過ぎても来なければ）、host はその device か口を閉じ / core §4.4: host は、前の confirm の下限が過ぎる前に次を送ってよく
divergences.fix: confirm_raw(floor=True) for the last confirm before deciding none came (_confirm_within, new confirm_tries); earlier repeats keep their short waits

divergences.spec: core §4.4: host は状態を変える要求の前に fn 0 の describe で max_op_ms を取得する。max_op_msをまだ取得していない間は、これらの処理上限にcore_quick_op_max_msを使う / core §6.5: open の応答も boot_id を持つ: 知っていた boot_id と比べる host は、open のときに再起動を知り
divergences.fix: an open whose boot_id shows a reboot (the old boot's describes dropped) reads fn 0's describe again right after, so the session's state-changing requests wait max_op_ms

divergences.spec: core §5.1: 再送を諦めたら、その経路の未解決の要求は結果不明となる。host は TCP では接続を閉じて開き直し、ほかの経路では [経路] §5 に従って立て直す。boot_id を確認し、状態を読んでから次の状態変更を判断する。
divergences.fix: a request given up without a resend on a serial port (COBS) also marks the transport failed, so recover_transport's confirm checks the boot_id before the next request (as TCP and an unanswered resend already did)

divergences.spec: oep-if-link §3 host: try/commit/revertの応答を失った場合は、起動時/試した速さでconfirmと新しいcorrのport_stateを使って復旧する。
divergences.fix: when the revert's answer was lost, after the confirm at the boot speed a new-corr port_state is read and anything but (boot baud, phase 0) raises ConnectionError (as raise_speed's back() did)
